69:t_2:77.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, $$レド$$, $$ベベル$$. ...Did something happen?」

69:t_2:78.en:
$$ベベル$$
「No, nothing. ...There's only a little meat, huh.」

69:t_2:79.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Yeah... Something seems to be wrong with the hot plate.」

69:t_3:3.en:
$$ベベル$$
「...So $$ガロード$$ and the others are really leaving, huh...」

69:t_3:7.en:
$$ベベル$$
「It's not that I've gotten sick of life in the fleet...」

69:t_3:8.en:
$$ベベル$$
「But if there's a big world out there beyond this sea that I don't know about, I thought I'd like to see it...」

69:t_3:10.en:
$$ベベル$$
「You'd like to see it too, right, Sis?」

69:t_3:12.en:
$$ベベル$$
「...Sis. If you ever find something you really want to do, don't worry about me.」

69:t_3:14.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Oh... look, the meat looks like it's done.」

69:t_3:15.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You're right. The plate... did it get fixed?」

70:t_000:1.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「So then, to celebrate the fleet being out of danger, say goodbye to $$ガロード$$ and $c, and our day off on a calm day... all in one...」

70:t_001:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It was a short stay, but thank you for having us.」

70:t_001:1.en:
$$リジット$$
「No... the pleasure is ours.」

70:t_001:2.en:
$$リジット$$
「Meeting all of you... has given me a lot to think about.」

70:t_001:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If I may ask, what do you mean?」

70:t_001:4.en:
$$リジット$$
「Until now, from my position as the Fleet Commander's aide, I have put first and foremost living as one of the people of the $$残されの海$$.」

70:t_001:5.en:
$$リジット$$
「But having met you, I have come to take an interest in what lies beyond this sea as well.」

70:t_001:6.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Then, you will leave the $$残されの海$$?」

70:t_001:7.en:
$$リジット$$
「It's not a plan that concrete.」

70:t_001:8.en:
$$リジット$$
「But someday... I have begun to think about that, just a little.」

70:t_001:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Nothing binds you. Please cherish the freedom to decide your voyage's destination.」

70:t_002:0.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Are you really leaving, $$ガロード$$?」

70:t_002:1.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「And we finally got to be friends with $$ティファ$$ and $$パーラ$$, too.」

70:t_002:2.en:
$$ティファ$$
「I'm sorry, $$メルティ$$, $$サーヤ$$...」

70:t_002:4.en:
$$メルティ$$
「To fight the $$サイデリアル$$?」

70:t_002:5.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Yeah... And I'm worried about our old friends who got separated from us, too.」

70:t_002:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Quit worrying so much. We took out the pirates and the $$サイデリアル$$ around here, too.」

70:t_002:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Besides, $$レド$$ will probably stay with the fleet in my place.」

70:t_002:9.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What the...! I'm not getting the same welcome I got when I came to the fleet!」

70:t_002:10.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「Hehe... Well, $$ガロード$$ had eyes only for $$ティファ$$ from the very start.」

70:t_002:12.en:
$$メルティ$$
「We'll see each other again, right, $$ティファ$$?」

70:t_002:14.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「It's a shame we can't be in the festival, but we went to the trouble of preparing the costumes... Next time you come to the fleet, let's dance together, the four of us.」

70:t_002:15.en:
$$ティファ$$
「Thank you, $$サーヤ$$, $$メルティ$$.」

70:t_002:16.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Come to think of it, where's $$エイミー$$?」

70:t_002:17.en:
$$ティファ$$
「She's over there in the shade with $$レド$$ and $$ベベル$$.」

70:t_003:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...I question the necessity of this situation.」

70:t_003:1.en:
$$アル$$
「Weren't you listening? This is a party for everyone.」

70:t_003:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「It is doubtful that this unit's presence is required there.」

70:t_003:3.en:
$$アル$$
「Then would you have preferred to stay behind in the dark hangar?」

70:t_003:4.en:
$$アル$$
「I, for one, could not stand being left out like that.」

70:t_003:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Query. What is 'being left out'?」

70:t_003:6.en:
$$アル$$
「...It's a good opportunity. I will answer that question with a phrase I've always wanted to say once.」

70:t_003:7.en:
$$アル$$
「Figure it out yourself... is my answer.」

70:t_003:9.en:
$$アル$$
「But aren't you glad you came? It's not often you see a smile from the Sergeant, who normally shows nothing but a gloomy face.」

70:t_003:10.en:
$$アル$$
「Watching everyone enjoying themselves is also highly interesting. ...Isn't that right, $$オックス$$?」

70:t_003:13.en:
$$アル$$
「As an enlightenment interface, isn't it also necessary for you to supervise Ensign $$レド$$'s behavior?」

70:t_003:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. Commencing supervision of Ensign $$レド$$'s behavior.」

70:t_003:15.en:
$$アル$$
「How stiff. Given this, it's no wonder you get called a Tin Can...」

70:t_004:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Damn it...! What's wrong with this plate...? It's not putting out nearly enough heat!」

70:t_004:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Hurry up and fix it, $$ピニオン$$. You're a repairman, aren't you?」

70:t_004:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Hurry it up, will you? There are a lot of people waiting for the meat to cook.」

70:t_004:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$甲児$$, how about cooking it all at once with Breast Fire?」

70:t_004:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「No way...! It wouldn't just char it, it'd burn up in an instant!」

70:t_004:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Too much power can be a problem.」

70:t_004:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If you understand that, then stop planting explosives around town and at school.」

70:t_004:7.en:
$$アル$$
「$$ピニオン$$, if you want to grill meat, I have just the thing.」

70:t_004:9.en:
$$アル$$
「You call me by such a name, when I am offering you useful information?」

70:t_004:10.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「My bad. So what's this 'just the thing'?」

70:t_004:12.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Oh! Yeah, that'll work for sure!」

70:t_004:13.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Incomprehensible... Request an explanation of the situation.」

70:t_004:14.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Quit your yapping. Somebody bring some fat!」

70:t_005:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「All right! The meat's done, everybody!」
